from pathlib import Path

p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]) for c in range(col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]))
            row.append(1 if n > 1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
